text: 🇲🇽✊ "When Mexico trusts in the intelligence and creativity of its people, there is no limit that can stop it." "Olinia is the hope of a Mexico that recognizes in its youth the strength of its present and its future. Because when Mexico trusts in the intelligence and creativity of its people, there is no limit that can stop it." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, presenting Olinia in Zumpango, June 7 Manufacturing target: 10,000 units in 2027. First deliveries summer 2027. Designed by young Mexican engineers over 18 months. The 4T's industrial doctrine in one prototype.

🇲🇽🎨 "Knowledge is one of the greatest riches of a nation." "Olinia is the vision of a country that understands that knowledge is one of the greatest riches of a nation." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, presenting Olinia in Zumpango, June 7 The maquila doctrine assigned Mexico the role of cheap labor importing foreign technology. Plan México inverts that — Mexican engineering, Mexican design, Mexican manufacturing. Olinia is the prototype of that inversion.

🇲🇽🏭 "Mexico was not made only for the maquila." "For a long time they spoke of Mexico as a country destined only to produce what others imagined. They told us 'we can't,' 'we shouldn't.' That innovation was reserved for other places. That Mexico was made only for the maquila. That our role was to receive technology, not develop it. To receive ideas, not create them. That is false." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, presenting Olinia in Zumpango, June 7 Olinia: Mexico's first domestically-designed electric vehicle. 150,000 pesos, 125 km range, 50% Mexican content rising to 75% by 2030. Designed in 18 months by young Mexican engineers.

🇲🇽⚖️ "Teacher by teacher, school by school." "The President has instructed us that every teacher should have their say. We're going to listen — teacher by teacher, school by school. We'll do that in August, at the start of the school year." — Mario Delgado, Education Secretary, on the CNTE / ISSSTE pension reform consultation The CNTE demands repealing the 2007 ISSSTE law. The government is opening a nationwide consultation before drafting reform legislation. A structural negotiation built with the teachers, not imposed on them.

🇲🇽⚽ Few heads of state will attend the Mundial opening. South Africa's president cancelled. "Few heads of state will come to the inauguration. The leaders decided to attend to situations in their own countries." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, on June 11 attendance at Estadio Azteca Mexico, the US, and Canada co-host the 2026 World Cup. Mexico opens the tournament. King Felipe VI confirmed for Guadalajara. South Africa's president cancelled. No confirmation from Trump or Carney for the country opening their own tournament.

🇲🇽✊ "Mexico is different from other countries. Here, the government has strength with the people." "But Mexico is different from other countries. Here, the government has a lot of strength with the people." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, asked whether US media campaigns could destabilize Mexico The 4T's answer to regime-change playbooks isn't denial — it's the 80%+ approval rating built voter by voter since 2018. That base is the moat. No filtered story in an English-language paper moves it.

🇲🇽🌎 The US far-right and Mexico's far-right are coordinating against the bilateral relationship. "I think this will continue — these false stories, these attempts at preventing a good relationship — from the US far-right that joins with the Mexican far-right. We have to stay very alert." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, naming the LA Times and the New York Times Same playbook used against AMLO. Now escalated against Morenista governors as US midterms approach and Mexico's 2027 elections come into focus. Sheinbaum no longer pretends the campaign is journalism.

🇲🇽🌎 "It's time to defend sovereignty." "What comes out of LA has to do with groups leaking false news, testing if it sticks, pressuring sectors over there. That's why I repeat: it's time to defend sovereignty." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, on the LA Times report targeting Morenista governors The LA Times claimed US authorities are investigating governors Alfonso Durazo (Sonora) and Américo Villarreal (Tamaulipas). Both rejected the accusations. Sheinbaum named the method: leak, pressure, repeat. Then she named the source: ultra-right networks in both countries.
